title: Analyse von Störungen und Dispositionen im ÖPNV
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: In this work, disruptions and dispositions in public transport are analysed using different methods. Interviews and observations are conducted within control centres and data from the ITCS is analysed. From this, influencing factors on the scheduling of public transport are derived. The main finding is that the interaction with motorised private transport has a decisive influence on the reliability of public transport.
